shell_commands: pwd && ls -la round-brief.md 2>&1 || echo "Not in workspace"

git add CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
docs: document onError fix for non-Error rejections

`onError` hook now fires for all rejections, including non-Error ones.
Non-Error values are wrapped in an Error with `cause` preserving the
original value, so hooks can inspect either form. The rejection to the
caller remains unchanged.

Closes #95
EOF
)"
git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main --no-edit
